content.short: MistTrack is a crypto tracking and compliance platform built by the SlowMist team.
content.description: MistTrack is an anti-money laundering (AML) tracking tool that helps investigators examine cross-chain transactions and strengthen DeFi project compliance. By tracing activity across multiple blockchains, it supports proactive due diligence and risk assessment in decentralized finance. The tool has been used in projects including Huobi, Binance, MultiChain, PancakeSwap, and Crypto.com, underscoring its role in real-world security and regulatory contexts. It emphasizes monitoring and analytics to detect suspicious patterns and bolster governance, security, and compliance programs across Web3 ecosystems.
